description: The plot shows how the number of “Shared Experts for Two Samples” varies with “Sample Token Count” for six categories (Intent, Summary, Law, Translation, Code, Math). The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and uses a logarithmic base-2 scale with tick labels from \(2^9\) through \(2^{20}\) at every power of two. The y-axis is labeled “Shared Experts for Two Samples,” appears linear, and spans roughly from about 2.0 up to 6.0 with labeled ticks at 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, …, 6.0. The Intent line is orange, solid, with no markers; it starts near 3.8 at \(2^9\), rises to about 4.3 at \(2^{10}\), dips to about 3.9 at \(2^{11}\), then increases to around 5.2 at \(2^{12}\), about 5.5 at \(2^{13}\), stays around 5.5–5.7 through \(2^{17}\), and reaches about 6.0 by \(2^{19}\)–\(2^{20}\). The Summary line is blue, solid; it begins near 1.9 at \(2^9\), increases to about 3.2 at \(2^{10}\) and about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), dips slightly to about 4.5 at \(2^{12}\), then climbs to about 4.7 at \(2^{13}\), about 5.4 at \(2^{14}\), about 5.7 at \(2^{15}\), and approaches about 5.9–6.0 from \(2^{17}\) to \(2^{20}\). The Law line is yellow/gold, solid; it starts around 3.6 at \(2^9\), rises to about 4.2 at \(2^{10}\) and about 5.0 at \(2^{11}\), dips to about 4.6 at \(2^{12}\), increases to about 5.6 at \(2^{13}\) and about 5.8 at \(2^{14}\), sits near 5.5–5.9 from \(2^{15}\) onward, and is around 6.0 by \(2^{18}\)–\(2^{20}\). The Translation line is purple, solid; it begins near 5.1 at \(2^9\), rises to about 5.3 at \(2^{10}\), drops to about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), jumps to about 5.6 at \(2^{12}\), stays around 5.6–5.9 from \(2^{13}\) through \(2^{20}\), ending just under 6.0. The Code line is gray, solid; it starts near 1.9 at \(2^9\) and remains near 2.0 at \(2^{10}\), increases to about 2.9 at \(2^{11}\) and about 3.1 at \(2^{12}\), rises to about 3.7 at \(2^{13}\), dips to about 3.1 at \(2^{14}\), then increases to about 4.1 at \(2^{15}\), about 4.8 at \(2^{16}\), about 5.3 at \(2^{17}\)–\(2^{18}\), and reaches about 5.7–5.8 by \(2^{19}\)–\(2^{20}\). The Math line is green, solid; it starts around 3.8 at \(2^9\), rises to about 4.2 at \(2^{10}\), about 4.6 at \(2^{11}\), about 5.0 at \(2^{12}\), about 5.3 at \(2^{13}\)–\(2^{14}\), increases to about 5.5 at \(2^{15}\), about 5.7 at \(2^{16}\), about 5.9 at \(2^{17}\)–\(2^{18}\), dips slightly near 5.8 at \(2^{19}\), and returns to about 5.9 at \(2^{20}\).
